text: You carve up the forest dragon and find some strange materials amidst its shimmering bones.
The snakelike tail twitches with every cut, as if a breath of life still lingered in it.
The red scales of the great creature mingle with the drops of blood on the ground.
The dead creature's powerful muscles emit a crackling sound with every cut, as if they were still charged with electricity.
You search through the mushrooms for a specimen that looks reasonably edible.
You carefully cut through the meat so as not to burn yourself on the still hot feathers.
You notice some strange organs, perhaps harvestable via careful dissection.
Your butchering tool destroys a strange organ.  Perhaps a more surgical approach would allow harvesting it.
